name: アーケード
css: /* --- Background Frame (修正: ルーレットと同じ位置へ) --- */
.led-lights { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; animation: led-blink 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
.led-1 { top: 2%; left: 10%; width: 15px; height: 15px; background: #ff0000; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #ff0000; animation-delay: 0s; }
.led-2 { top: 2%; right: 10%; width: 15px; height: 15px; background: #ffff00; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #ffff00; animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.led-3 { bottom: 2%; left: 10%; width: 15px; height: 15px; background: #00ff00; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #00ff00; animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.led-4 { bottom: 2%; right: 10%; width: 15px; height: 15px; background: #00ffff; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #00ffff; animation-delay: 0.6s; }
/* --- Pointer (修正: ルーレット上部へ) --- */
/* ルーレット上端(20px) + 微調整 */
@keyframes pointer-glow { from { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 15px #ff0000); } to { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 25px #ff0000) drop-shadow(0 0 35px #ff0000); } }

.button-outer { position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg, #ff0000 0deg 45deg, #ffff00 45deg 90deg, #00ff00 90deg 135deg, #00ffff 135deg 180deg, #0000ff 180deg 225deg, #ff00ff 225deg 270deg, #ff0000 270deg 315deg, #ffff00 315deg 360deg); border-radius: 50%; animation: rainbow-spin 3s linear infinite; opacity: 0.8; }
@keyframes rainbow-spin { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

.button-inner { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 75%; height: 75%; border-radius: 50%; background: #1a1a2e; border: 4px solid #00ff00; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; color: #00ff00; text-shadow: 0 0 10px #00ff00; font-weight: bold; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.5), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); animation: pulse-green 1s ease-in-out infinite; }

@keyframes pulse-green { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.5), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.8), inset 0 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); } }
/* --- UI Elements (修正: 下部配置) --- */
display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
